findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Functional. When a workflow failure is queued during a busy turn and its rerun starts within 60 seconds, the next board refresh still reads the failed occurrence from the checks cache (`src/forge/board.py:104`). At turn completion, `latest.has(id)` remains true, so this guard submits the obsolete failure. The new test advances `FORGE_NOW` by a full minute between responses (`tests/test_mod_plugin.py:248`), missing this normal sequence.
findings.title: A queued CI failure is delivered after a rerun starts within the cache window

why: A stopped forge work can leave its item lock behind, and forge stop says there is nothing to stop, so the next round is refused as busy
